close_reason: Changed sent_value serialization to use .map_err()?  instead of .unwrap_or_else(). Left email_updated loop entry unchanged (per-entry scope, Email can't fail to serialize anyway).
description: In handle_mdn_send (mdn.rs lines 466-469 and 470-474), serde_json::to_value uses .unwrap_or_else(|e| json!({"type": "serverFail", ...})). If serialization somehow failed, the sent or notSent field would contain an error-like JSON object indistinguishable from a valid MDN map entry — a silently malformed response the client cannot detect. Idiomatic Rust: use .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))? to propagate properly. In practice serde never fails for HashMap<String, Mdn>, but the fallback pattern is wrong regardless.
title: serde to_value unwrap_or_else silently corrupts MDN/send response on serialize failure
